text:
Short afternoon or not, we welcome your full message. You report that your companion animal was handled without enough care during a transfer and that the guidance you received felt unclear and unhelpful.

We take that complaint seriously. At Aurelia Skyways, the Companion Animal Travel Desk relies on a ground team that moves carriers carefully between services, checks each handoff, and keeps handling calm and orderly. When a traveler feels that this standard was not met, we review the path taken by the carrier, the notes entered by the service team, and the communication given at each stage. That review is already under way.

Your experience suggests a gap in both handling and guidance, and that is not the standard we expect. Our travel guidance is meant to be concise, kind, and actionable, so that a traveler can move through the process without confusion and with confidence that the pet is being treated properly. If the directions given to you were too vague or were delivered too late, we will address that with the staff involved and reinforce the correct sequence for future trips.

We also want to note that pet welfare remains our first operational concern. The carrier should be secured, carried level, and placed only where approved procedures allow. If any delay, rough movement, or missed reassurance occurred, we will record it and use it in follow-up coaching. Our desk will also check whether a service note should be added to your file so later travel is smoother.

Please accept our apology for the stress this caused. We understand that a companion animal is not ordinary baggage, and our handling must reflect that fact at every step. We will continue to monitor the matter, improve the response given to you, and ensure that the next interaction is clearer, steadier, and more respectful.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
